name: Super Simple Social Share Icons
author: Volt Blocks

sections.description:
Super Simple Social Share Icons provides an elegant and efficient way to add social sharing functionality to your WordPress site. With a focus on performance and user experience, this plugin offers customizable sharing buttons for popular social networks.

Features

  • Clean, modern design with multiple style options
  • Support for major social networks (Facebook, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Bluesky)
  • Customizable button styles (Brand colors, Light, Dark, Custom)
  • Flexible positioning (Above content, Below content, or Both)
  • Shortcode support for custom placement
  • Adjustable icon sizes and spacing
  • Mobile-friendly and responsive design
  • No external dependencies or tracking scripts
  • Lightweight and performance-focused

Supported Networks

  • Facebook
  • X (formerly Twitter)
  • LinkedIn
  • Pinterest
  • WhatsApp
  • Bluesky

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/super-simple-social-share-icons directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->Social Share screen to configure the plugin
  4. Choose your preferred networks and customize the appearance
sections.faq:
Can I control where the sharing buttons appear?

Yes, you can choose to display the buttons above content, below content, or both. You can also use the shortcode [super_simple_share] to place the buttons anywhere in your content.

Do you support custom colors?

Yes, you can choose from preset styles (Brand colors, Light, Dark) or set custom colors for the background, icons, and borders.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No, Super Simple Social Share Icons is built with performance in mind. It loads minimal CSS and JavaScript, and only when needed.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes, the plugin doesn’t track users or load any external scripts. It simply generates sharing links that users can click to share your content.
